content_sections.heading: About SMP Kolkata
content_sections.text: Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, Kolkata, formerly Kolkata Port Trust, is a Major Port Authority with its office at 15, Strand Road, Kolkata - 700 001. The post is under its Kolkata Dock System and will fall vacant with effect from 1 February 2027. The circular is addressed to the Secretaries of all Major Port Authorities.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from suitable and willing officers who satisfy the notified Recruitment Rules for the post of Dy. Chief Engineer (Annexure-I of the circular). Applications are routed through the applicant's Administrative Port. The crucial date for determining eligibility is 1 February 2027. Degree or equivalent in Civil Engg from a recognized University/Institution (4 year Degree course). Nine years experience in executive cadre in Planning/Construction/Design/Maintenance preferably of Port and Marine Structures in an Industrial/Commercial/Govt. Undertaking. The Recruitment Rules list the post as filled by absorption through composite method, failing which by deputation from other Govt. organizations, and failing both by direct recruitment. For absorption, the following officers are eligible: Officers holding analogous posts, or the post of Superintending Engineer and equivalent posts in the respective discipline of Civil Engg. Deptt. in the scale of pay of Rs.24,900-50,500/- with 3 years regular service in the grade in a Major Port Trust; or Superintending Engr. and equivalent post in the respective discipline of Civil Engg. Deptt. with 2 years regular service in the grade and a combined regular service of 7 years in the scale of pay of Rs. 20,600-46,500/- and Rs. 24,900-46,500/- in Civil Engg. Department of any Major Port Trust. For deputation, the Recruitment Rules make eligible officers holding analogous posts, or the post of Superintending Engineer and equivalent posts in the respective discipline of Civil Engg. Deptt. in the scale of pay of Rs.24,900-50,500/- with 3 years regular service in the grade in Govt./PSUs/Autonomous bodies. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, candidates should see Annexure-I of the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Dy. Chief Engineer post carries the pay scale of Rs. 80,000-2,20,000/- (pre-revised Rs. 32,900-58,000/-) and is a Class-I post. Under the Ministry's letter No. A-29018/4/2018-PE-I dated 30.05.2022 and 01.06.2022, the Appointing Authority as well as the Disciplinary Authority for all Dy. HOD level posts is the Central Government, i.e. Secretary (PSW). The notice does not mention allowances.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SMP Kolkata Dy. Chief Engineer (Dy. CE)
content_sections.text: Register on the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the MoPS&W website, onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in. Apply for the post of Dy. Chief Engineer (Dy. CE) through OAP between 3 November 2026 and 2 December 2026. Take a printout of the filled-in application and put it in an envelope with the documents listed below. Superscribe the envelope "Application for the post of Dy. Chief Engineer (Dy. CE)". Send it through your Administrative Port, which verifies the certificates while forwarding the application. The envelope must reach the Office of the Secretary, Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, Kolkata, 15 Strand Road, Kolkata-700001 on or before 17 December 2026. Certified copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years, attested on each page by an officer not below the rank of Dy. HOD. Attested copies of all certificates of educational qualification and present and past work experience in the respective post and pay scale, verified by the administrative port. For appointment or promotion on "officiating", "ad-hoc" or "pro-forma" basis, the details of "regularization" should be indicated clearly. Administrative Certificate / No objection certificate from the competent authority of the respective Port (Annexure-II). It certifies, among other things, that no disciplinary or vigilance case is pending, the officer's integrity, the APARs from 2021-2022 to 2025-26, and that the Port has no objection to releasing the officer if selected. Undertaking of the applicant that the candidature will not be withdrawn, if selected. Vigilance comments / clearance certificate in the pro-forma at Annexure-III, prescribed by CVC vide circular No. 01.03.2026 dated 12.03.2026, including details of penalties, if any, in the last ten years (Sl. No. 10 of Annexure-III). It is to be furnished and signed by the CVO or HOD. Self attested passport size photographs (two numbers).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: According to the Recruitment Rules, selection is by merit, for which the benchmark in overall grading in the APARs will not be below "very good". The recommendations of the Service Selection Committee will be conveyed to the Ministry for approval before the appointment order is issued.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SMP Kolkata Dy. Chief Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one post of Dy. Chief Engineer (Dy. CE) in the Civil Engineering Department of the Kolkata Dock System.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the SMP Kolkata Dy. Chief Engineer post?
faq.answer: The online application through OAP closes on 2 December 2026, and the printout with documents must reach SMP Kolkata through the Administrative Port on or before 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the SMP Kolkata Dy. Chief Engineer post?
faq.answer: A degree or equivalent in Civil Engg from a recognized University/Institution (4 year Degree course) and nine years experience in executive cadre in Planning/Construction/Design/Maintenance, preferably of Port and Marine Structures, in an Industrial/Commercial/Govt. Undertaking.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible for absorption to the Dy. Chief Engineer post?
faq.answer: Officers holding analogous posts or Superintending Engineer and equivalent posts in Civil Engg. Deptt. in the scale of Rs.24,900-50,500/- with 3 years regular service in a Major Port Trust, or with 2 years regular service in the grade and 7 years combined regular service in the scales of Rs. 20,600-46,500/- and Rs. 24,900-46,500/- in any Major Port Trust.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of SMP Kolkata Dy. Chief Engineer?
faq.answer: The post carries the pay scale of Rs. 80,000-2,20,000/- (pre-revised Rs. 32,900-58,000/-).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the SMP Kolkata Dy. CE post?
faq.answer: Register and apply on the MoPS&W OAP (onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in), then send the printout with the listed documents through your Administrative Port in an envelope marked "Application for the post of Dy. Chief Engineer (Dy. CE)" to the Office of the Secretary, Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, Kolkata, 15 Strand Road, Kolkata-700001.

faq.question: Q7. How will the Dy. Chief Engineer be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by merit with a benchmark of not below "very good" in overall APAR grading; the Service Selection Committee's recommendations go to the Ministry for approval before the appointment order.

faq.question: Q8. What happens if a selected officer withdraws candidature?
faq.answer: Port officials who withdraw after selection by the Service Selection Committee are liable for debarment from future selection to Dy. HoD level posts in all Major Port Authorities for two years.

faq.question: Q9. What is the crucial date for eligibility?
faq.answer: The crucial date for determining eligibility is 1 February 2027, the date from which the post falls vacant.
